Q1a.en: Separate the variables: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x}e^{y}\), so \(e^{-y}\,dy = e^{x}\,dx\). Integrating both sides, \(-e^{-y} = e^{x} + k\), that is \(e^{x} + e^{-y} = c\) (where \(c = -k\)). This is the choice \(e^{x} + e^{-y} = c\).
Q1a.hi: चरों को पृथक करने पर: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x}e^{y}\), अतः \(e^{-y}\,dy = e^{x}\,dx\)। दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर \(-e^{-y} = e^{x} + k\), अर्थात् \(e^{x} + e^{-y} = c\) (जहाँ \(c = -k\))। यह विकल्प \(e^{x} + e^{-y} = c\) है।

Q1b.en: Let \(\tan^{-1} x = \theta\), so \(\tan\theta = x\) and \(\theta \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), where \(\sec\theta = \sqrt{1 + \tan^2\theta}\) is positive. Then \(\sin\theta = \tan\theta\cos\theta = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sec\theta} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\). This is the choice \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}\).
Q1b.hi: माना \(\tan^{-1} x = \theta\), तो \(\tan\theta = x\) तथा \(\theta \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), जहाँ \(\sec\theta = \sqrt{1 + \tan^2\theta}\) धनात्मक है। अतः \(\sin\theta = \tan\theta\cos\theta = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sec\theta} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\)। यह विकल्प \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}\) है।

Q1d.en: If \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), then \(2x_1 = 2x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\): the function is one-one. For any real number y, the real number \(x = \frac{y}{2}\) gives \(f(x) = y\), so the function is onto. Hence f is one-one and onto.
Q1d.hi: यदि \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), तो \(2x_1 = 2x_2\), अतः \(x_1 = x_2\): फलन एकैकी है। किसी भी वास्तविक संख्या y के लिए वास्तविक संख्या \(x = \frac{y}{2}\) लेने पर \(f(x) = y\) प्राप्त होता है, अतः फलन आच्छादक है। अतः f एकैकी एवं आच्छादक है।

Q2e.en: Expanding the dot product, \((\vec{x} - \vec{a}) \cdot (\vec{x} + \vec{a}) = |\vec{x}|^2 + \vec{x} \cdot \vec{a} - \vec{a} \cdot \vec{x} - |\vec{a}|^2 = |\vec{x}|^2 - |\vec{a}|^2 = 12\). Q2e.hi: अदिश गुणनफल का विस्तार करने पर \((\vec{x} - \vec{a}) \cdot (\vec{x} + \vec{a}) = |\vec{x}|^2 + \vec{x} \cdot \vec{a} - \vec{a} \cdot \vec{x} - |\vec{a}|^2 = |\vec{x}|^2 - |\vec{a}|^2 = 12\)। चूँकि \(\vec{a}\) मात्रक सदिश है, \(|\vec{a}| = 1\), अतः \(|\vec{x}|^2 = 13\) तथा \(|\vec{x}| = \sqrt{13}\)।

Q3a.en:
Find the vector product by the determinant formula, then its magnitude.
\(\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & 5 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\)
\(= \hat{i}(1 \cdot (-2) - 3 \cdot 5) - \hat{j}(2 \cdot (-2) - 3 \cdot 3) + \hat{k}(2 \cdot 5 - 1 \cdot 3)\)
\(= -17\hat{i} + 13\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\)
So \(|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{(-17)^2 + 13^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{289 + 169 + 49} = \sqrt{507} = 13\sqrt{3}\).
Q3a.hi:
सारणिक सूत्र से सदिश गुणनफल ज्ञात करके उसका परिमाण निकालते हैं।
\(\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & 5 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\)
\(= \hat{i}(1 \cdot (-2) - 3 \cdot 5) - \hat{j}(2 \cdot (-2) - 3 \cdot 3) + \hat{k}(2 \cdot 5 - 1 \cdot 3)\)
\(= -17\hat{i} + 13\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\)
अतः \(|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{(-17)^2 + 13^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{289 + 169 + 49} = \sqrt{507} = 13\sqrt{3}\)।

Q3b.en:
To show f is one-one, take \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) and show \(x_1 = x_2\). Note that \(f(x)\) has the same sign as x: \(f(x) \ge 0\) for \(x \ge 0\) and \(f(x) < 0\) for \(x < 0\).

Case 1: \(x_1, x_2 \ge 0\). Then \(\frac{2x_1}{1 + x_1} = \frac{2x_2}{1 + x_2}\) gives \(2x_1 + 2x_1x_2 = 2x_2 + 2x_1x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\).

Case 2: \(x_1, x_2 < 0\). Then \(\frac{2x_1}{1 - x_1} = \frac{2x_2}{1 - x_2}\) gives \(2x_1 - 2x_1x_2 = 2x_2 - 2x_1x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\).

Case 3: one of \(x_1, x_2\) is \(\ge 0\) and the other is \(< 0\). Then one of \(f(x_1), f(x_2)\) is \(\ge 0\) and the other is negative, so \(f(x_1) \ne f(x_2)\); this case cannot occur.

In every case \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) implies \(x_1 = x_2\). Hence f is one-one.

Q3c.en:
Here \((f + g)(x) = \sin x + \cos x\), \(x \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\). Take the two different points \(x = 0\) and \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) of the domain:
\((f + g)(0) = \sin 0 + \cos 0 = 0 + 1 = 1\)
\((f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \sin\frac{\pi}{2} + \cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 1 + 0 = 1\)
So \((f + g)(0) = (f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) although \(0 \ne \frac{\pi}{2}\). Two different elements have the same image, so \((f + g)\) is not one-one.
Q3c.hi:
यहाँ \((f + g)(x) = \sin x + \cos x\), \(x \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\)। प्रान्त के दो भिन्न बिन्दु \(x = 0\) तथा \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) लीजिए:
\((f + g)(0) = \sin 0 + \cos 0 = 0 + 1 = 1\)
\((f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \sin\frac{\pi}{2} + \cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 1 + 0 = 1\)
अतः \(0 \ne \frac{\pi}{2}\) होते हुए भी \((f + g)(0) = (f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)। दो भिन्न अवयवों का प्रतिबिम्ब एक ही है, अतः \((f + g)\) एकैकी नहीं है।

Q4a.en:
The line through the point \((x_1, y_1, z_1)\) with direction ratios a, b, c has the Cartesian equation \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\). Here the point is \((5, 2, -4)\), and since the line is parallel to \(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k}\), its direction ratios are 3, 2, -8. So the required equation is
\(\frac{x - 5}{3} = \frac{y - 2}{2} = \frac{z + 4}{-8}\).
Q4a.hi:
बिन्दु \((x_1, y_1, z_1)\) से जाने वाली तथा दिक्-अनुपात a, b, c वाली रेखा का कार्तीय समीकरण \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\) होता है। यहाँ बिन्दु \((5, 2, -4)\) है, तथा रेखा सदिश \(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k}\) के समान्तर है, अतः इसके दिक्-अनुपात 3, 2, -8 हैं। अतः अभीष्ट समीकरण है
\(\frac{x - 5}{3} = \frac{y - 2}{2} = \frac{z + 4}{-8}\)।

Q4b.en:
For \(x \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\), \(\frac{x}{2} \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{8}\right)\), so \(\cos\frac{x}{2} > \sin\frac{x}{2} > 0\).
Now \(1 + \sin x = \cos^2\frac{x}{2} + \sin^2\frac{x}{2} + 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2} = \left(\cos\frac{x}{2} + \sin\frac{x}{2}\right)^2\), so \(\sqrt{1 + \sin x} = \cos\frac{x}{2} + \sin\frac{x}{2}\).
Similarly \(1 - \sin x = \left(\cos\frac{x}{2} - \sin\frac{x}{2}\right)^2\), so \(\sqrt{1 - \sin x} = \cos\frac{x}{2} - \sin\frac{x}{2}\) (a positive quantity).
Hence \(\frac{\sqrt{1+\sin x} + \sqrt{1-\sin x}}{\sqrt{1+\sin x} - \sqrt{1-\sin x}} = \frac{2\cos\frac{x}{2}}{2\sin\frac{x}{2}} = \cot\frac{x}{2}\).
So the left side is \(\cot^{-1}\left(\cot\frac{x}{2}\right) = \frac{x}{2}\), because \(\frac{x}{2}\) lies in \((0, \pi)\), the principal value branch of \(\cot^{-1}\). Hence proved.
Q4b.hi:
\(x \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\) के लिए \(\frac{x}{2} \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{8}\right)\), अतः \(\cos\frac{x}{2} > \sin\frac{x}{2} > 0\)।
अब \(1 + \sin x = \cos^2\frac{x}{2} + \sin^2\frac{x}{2} + 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2} = \left(\cos\frac{x}{2} + \sin\frac{x}{2}\right)^2\), अतः \(\sqrt{1 + \sin x} = \cos\frac{x}{2} + \sin\frac{x}{2}\)।
इसी प्रकार \(1 - \sin x = \left(\cos\frac{x}{2} - \sin\frac{x}{2}\right)^2\), अतः \(\sqrt{1 - \sin x} = \cos\frac{x}{2} - \sin\frac{x}{2}\) (एक धनात्मक राशि)।
अतः \(\frac{\sqrt{1+\sin x} + \sqrt{1-\sin x}}{\sqrt{1+\sin x} - \sqrt{1-\sin x}} = \frac{2\cos\frac{x}{2}}{2\sin\frac{x}{2}} = \cot\frac{x}{2}\)।
इसलिए बायाँ पक्ष \(\cot^{-1}\left(\cot\frac{x}{2}\right) = \frac{x}{2}\), क्योंकि \(\frac{x}{2}\), \(\cot^{-1}\) की मुख्य मान शाखा \((0, \pi)\) में स्थित है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q4c.en:
Expand the determinant along the first row:
\(\Delta = a(cb - a^2) - b(b^2 - ac) + c(ab - c^2)\)
\(= abc - a^3 - b^3 + abc + abc - c^3\)
\(= 3abc - a^3 - b^3 - c^3\)
In factorised form, \(\Delta = -(a + b + c)(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - ab - bc - ca)\).
Q4c.hi:
सारणिक का प्रथम पंक्ति के अनुदिश प्रसार करने पर:
\(\Delta = a(cb - a^2) - b(b^2 - ac) + c(ab - c^2)\)
\(= abc - a^3 - b^3 + abc + abc - c^3\)
\(= 3abc - a^3 - b^3 - c^3\)
गुणनखंड रूप में, \(\Delta = -(a + b + c)(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - ab - bc - ca)\)।

Q4d.en:
By the addition theorem,
\(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = \frac{7}{13} + \frac{9}{13} - \frac{4}{13} = \frac{12}{13}\).
By the definition of conditional probability,
\(P(A/B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} = \frac{\frac{4}{13}}{\frac{9}{13}} = \frac{4}{9}\).
Q4d.hi:
प्रायिकता के योग प्रमेय से,
\(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = \frac{7}{13} + \frac{9}{13} - \frac{4}{13} = \frac{12}{13}\)।
सप्रतिबंध प्रायिकता की परिभाषा से,
\(P(A/B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} = \frac{\frac{4}{13}}{\frac{9}{13}} = \frac{4}{9}\)।

Q5a.en:
Since each vector is perpendicular to the sum of the other two,
\(\vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\), \(\vec{b} \cdot (\vec{c} + \vec{a}) = 0\), \(\vec{c} \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = 0\)
that is,
\(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{a} \cdot \vec{c} = 0\), \(\vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\), \(\vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\)
Adding these, and using \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a}\) and so on,
\(2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
Now
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c})\)
\(= |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a})\)
\(= 3^2 + 4^2 + 5^2 + 0 = 9 + 16 + 25 = 50\)
Hence \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2}\).
Q5a.hi:
चूँकि प्रत्येक सदिश अन्य दो सदिशों के योगफल पर लम्बवत् है,
\(\vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\), \(\vec{b} \cdot (\vec{c} + \vec{a}) = 0\), \(\vec{c} \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = 0\)
अर्थात्
\(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{a} \cdot \vec{c} = 0\), \(\vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\), \(\vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\)
इन्हें जोड़ने पर, तथा \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a}\) आदि का प्रयोग करने पर,
\(2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
अब
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c})\)
\(= |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a})\)
\(= 3^2 + 4^2 + 5^2 + 0 = 9 + 16 + 25 = 50\)
अतः \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2}\)।

Q5b.en:
Draw the boundary lines of the constraints:
- \(x + 2y = 120\), through (120, 0) and (0, 60)
- \(x + y = 60\), through (60, 0) and (0, 60)
- \(x - 2y = 0\), through (0, 0) and (120, 60)

The region \(x + 2y \le 120\) is on the origin side of the first line, \(x + y \ge 60\) is on the side away from the origin of the second line, and \(x - 2y \ge 0\) is the side of the line \(x = 2y\) that contains the point (1, 0), that is below it. Together with \(x \ge 0, y \ge 0\), the feasible region is the bounded quadrilateral with corner points:
- (60, 0), where \(x + y = 60\) meets \(y = 0\)
- (120, 0), where \(x + 2y = 120\) meets \(y = 0\)
- (60, 30), where \(x + 2y = 120\) meets \(x = 2y\) (\(4y = 120\), \(y = 30\))
- (40, 20), where \(x + y = 60\) meets \(x = 2y\) (\(3y = 60\), \(y = 20\))

Value of Z at the corner points:

| Corner point | \(Z = 5x + 10y\) |
|---|---|
| (60, 0) | 300 |
| (120, 0) | 600 |
| (60, 30) | 600 |
| (40, 20) | 400 |

The largest value, 600, occurs at both (120, 0) and (60, 30). Since \(Z = 5(x + 2y)\), the line of Z is parallel to the boundary \(x + 2y = 120\), so every point of the segment joining (120, 0) and (60, 30) also gives \(Z = 600\).

Hence the maximum value of Z is 600, attained at every point of the line segment joining (120, 0) and (60, 30).

Q5c.en:
Check the value and the two one-sided limits at \(x = 0\).
Value: \(f(0) = \lambda(0^2 - 2 \cdot 0) = 0\).
Left hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 0^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 0^-} \lambda(x^2 - 2x) = \lambda \cdot 0 = 0\).
Right hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 0^+} (4x + 1) = 4 \cdot 0 + 1 = 1\).
For f to be continuous at \(x = 0\), the left hand limit, the right hand limit and \(f(0)\) must be equal, that is \(0 = 1\), which is impossible whatever the value of \(\lambda\).
Hence there is no value of \(\lambda\) for which f is continuous at \(x = 0\).
Q5c.hi:
\(x = 0\) पर फलन का मान तथा दोनों पक्षों की सीमाएँ ज्ञात करते हैं।
मान: \(f(0) = \lambda(0^2 - 2 \cdot 0) = 0\)।
बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 0^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 0^-} \lambda(x^2 - 2x) = \lambda \cdot 0 = 0\)।
दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 0^+} (4x + 1) = 4 \cdot 0 + 1 = 1\)।
\(x = 0\) पर f के संतत होने के लिए बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा, दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा तथा \(f(0)\) बराबर होने चाहिए, अर्थात् \(0 = 1\), जो \(\lambda\) के किसी भी मान के लिए असम्भव है।
अतः \(\lambda\) का ऐसा कोई मान नहीं है जिसके लिए f, \(x = 0\) पर संतत हो।

Q5d.en:
Find the vectors \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) and \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) from the position vectors:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (2\hat{i} + 5\hat{j}) - (\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}) = \hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}\)
\(\overrightarrow{CD} = (\hat{i} - 6\hat{j} - \hat{k}) - (3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 3\hat{k}) = -2\hat{i} - 8\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\)
So \(|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{1 + 16 + 1} = 3\sqrt{2}\), \(|\overrightarrow{CD}| = \sqrt{4 + 64 + 4} = 6\sqrt{2}\), and
\(\overrightarrow{AB} \cdot \overrightarrow{CD} = (1)(-2) + (4)(-8) + (-1)(2) = -2 - 32 - 2 = -36\).
If \(\theta\) is the angle between AB and CD,
\(\cos\theta = \frac{\overrightarrow{AB} \cdot \overrightarrow{CD}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|\,|\overrightarrow{CD}|} = \frac{-36}{3\sqrt{2} \times 6\sqrt{2}} = \frac{-36}{36} = -1\)
so \(\theta = \pi\).
Collinearity: \(\overrightarrow{CD} = -2\hat{i} - 8\hat{j} + 2\hat{k} = -2(\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}) = -2\,\overrightarrow{AB}\). One vector is a scalar multiple of the other (equivalently, the angle between them is \(\pi\)), so \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) and \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) are collinear: they are parallel and point in opposite directions. Hence AB and CD are collinear, and the lines AB and CD are parallel.
Q5d.hi:
स्थिति सदिशों से सदिश \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) तथा \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) ज्ञात कीजिए:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (2\hat{i} + 5\hat{j}) - (\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}) = \hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}\)
\(\overrightarrow{CD} = (\hat{i} - 6\hat{j} - \hat{k}) - (3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 3\hat{k}) = -2\hat{i} - 8\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\)
अतः \(|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{1 + 16 + 1} = 3\sqrt{2}\), \(|\overrightarrow{CD}| = \sqrt{4 + 64 + 4} = 6\sqrt{2}\), तथा
\(\overrightarrow{AB} \cdot \overrightarrow{CD} = (1)(-2) + (4)(-8) + (-1)(2) = -2 - 32 - 2 = -36\)।
यदि AB तथा CD के बीच का कोण \(\theta\) है, तो
\(\cos\theta = \frac{\overrightarrow{AB} \cdot \overrightarrow{CD}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|\,|\overrightarrow{CD}|} = \frac{-36}{3\sqrt{2} \times 6\sqrt{2}} = \frac{-36}{36} = -1\)
अतः \(\theta = \pi\)।
संरेखता: \(\overrightarrow{CD} = -2\hat{i} - 8\hat{j} + 2\hat{k} = -2(\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}) = -2\,\overrightarrow{AB}\)। एक सदिश दूसरे का अदिश गुणज है (अर्थात् इनके बीच का कोण \(\pi\) है), अतः \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) तथा \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) संरेख हैं: ये समान्तर हैं और विपरीत दिशाओं में हैं। अतः AB और CD संरेख हैं, तथा रेखाएँ AB और CD समान्तर हैं।

Q5e.en:
First simplify: \(f(x) = \frac{4\sin x - x(2 + \cos x)}{2 + \cos x} = \frac{4\sin x}{2 + \cos x} - x\).
Differentiating with respect to x,
\(f'(x) = \frac{4\cos x(2 + \cos x) - 4\sin x(-\sin x)}{(2 + \cos x)^2} - 1 = \frac{8\cos x + 4\cos^2 x + 4\sin^2 x}{(2 + \cos x)^2} - 1 = \frac{8\cos x + 4}{(2 + \cos x)^2} - 1\)
\(= \frac{8\cos x + 4 - (4 + 4\cos x + \cos^2 x)}{(2 + \cos x)^2} = \frac{4\cos x - \cos^2 x}{(2 + \cos x)^2} = \frac{\cos x\,(4 - \cos x)}{(2 + \cos x)^2}\)
Since \(-1 \le \cos x \le 1\), we have \(4 - \cos x > 0\) and \((2 + \cos x)^2 > 0\). So \(f'(x)\) has the sign of \(\cos x\), and in \([0, 2\pi]\), \(f'(x) = 0\) at \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) and \(x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\). These points divide \([0, 2\pi]\) into three intervals:

| Interval | Sign of \(\cos x\) | Sign of \(f'(x)\) | f is |
|---|---|---|---|
| \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) | + | + | strictly increasing |
| \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)\) | - | - | strictly decreasing |
| \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\right)\) | + | + | strictly increasing |

Hence f is strictly increasing in \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) and \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\right)\), and strictly decreasing in \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)\). (Since \(f'(x)\) has period \(2\pi\), the same pattern repeats in every interval of length \(2\pi\).)
Q5e.hi:
पहले सरल कीजिए: \(f(x) = \frac{4\sin x - x(2 + \cos x)}{2 + \cos x} = \frac{4\sin x}{2 + \cos x} - x\)।
x के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर,
\(f'(x) = \frac{4\cos x(2 + \cos x) - 4\sin x(-\sin x)}{(2 + \cos x)^2} - 1 = \frac{8\cos x + 4\cos^2 x + 4\sin^2 x}{(2 + \cos x)^2} - 1 = \frac{8\cos x + 4}{(2 + \cos x)^2} - 1\)
\(= \frac{8\cos x + 4 - (4 + 4\cos x + \cos^2 x)}{(2 + \cos x)^2} = \frac{4\cos x - \cos^2 x}{(2 + \cos x)^2} = \frac{\cos x\,(4 - \cos x)}{(2 + \cos x)^2}\)
चूँकि \(-1 \le \cos x \le 1\), अतः \(4 - \cos x > 0\) तथा \((2 + \cos x)^2 > 0\)। इसलिए \(f'(x)\) का चिह्न वही है जो \(\cos x\) का है, तथा \([0, 2\pi]\) में \(f'(x) = 0\) बिन्दुओं \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) तथा \(x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\) पर है। ये बिन्दु \([0, 2\pi]\) को तीन अन्तरालों में बाँटते हैं:

| अन्तराल | \(\cos x\) का चिह्न | \(f'(x)\) का चिह्न | f |
|---|---|---|---|
| \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) | + | + | निरन्तर वर्धमान |
| \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)\) | - | - | निरन्तर ह्रासमान |
| \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\right)\) | + | + | निरन्तर वर्धमान |

अतः f अन्तरालों \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) तथा \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\right)\) में निरन्तर वर्धमान है, तथा \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)\) में निरन्तर ह्रासमान है। (चूँकि \(f'(x)\) का आवर्तकाल \(2\pi\) है, यही क्रम \(2\pi\) लम्बाई के प्रत्येक अन्तराल में दोहराया जाता है।)

Q6b.en:
'At least one of A and B happens' is the event \(A \cup B\). Its complement is 'neither happens', and by De Morgan's law \((A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'\).
Since A and B are independent, \(P(A \cap B) = P(A)\,P(B)\). Then
\(P(A' \cap B') = P((A \cup B)') = 1 - P(A \cup B) = 1 - [P(A) + P(B) - P(A)P(B)]\)
\(= 1 - P(A) - P(B) + P(A)P(B) = [1 - P(A)][1 - P(B)] = P(A')\,P(B')\)
Therefore the probability that at least one of A and B happens is
\(P(A \cup B) = 1 - P(A' \cap B') = 1 - P(A')\,P(B')\).
Hence the required probability is \([1 - P(A')P(B')]\). Proved.
Q6b.hi:
'A और B में से न्यूनतम एक घटित होना' घटना \(A \cup B\) है। इसकी पूरक घटना 'दोनों में से कोई घटित न होना' है, और डी-मॉर्गन नियम से \((A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'\)।
चूँकि A और B स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं, \(P(A \cap B) = P(A)\,P(B)\)। तब
\(P(A' \cap B') = P((A \cup B)') = 1 - P(A \cup B) = 1 - [P(A) + P(B) - P(A)P(B)]\)
\(= 1 - P(A) - P(B) + P(A)P(B) = [1 - P(A)][1 - P(B)] = P(A')\,P(B')\)
अतः A और B में से न्यूनतम एक के घटित होने की प्रायिकता
\(P(A \cup B) = 1 - P(A' \cap B') = 1 - P(A')\,P(B')\)।
अतः अभीष्ट प्रायिकता \([1 - P(A')P(B')]\) है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q6c.en:
Let O be the centre of the sphere of radius r, and let the vertex P of the cone lie on the sphere. The base of the cone is a circle of the sphere whose centre M lies on PO produced, with \(OM = x\) (\(0 \le x < r\)).
Height of the cone: \(h = PM = r + x\).
If R is the radius of the base, then from the right triangle formed by O, M and a point on the rim of the base, \(R^2 = r^2 - x^2\).
Volume of the cone:
\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi R^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi (r^2 - x^2)(r + x) = \frac{\pi}{3}(r^3 + r^2x - rx^2 - x^3)\)
Differentiating with respect to x,
\(\frac{dV}{dx} = \frac{\pi}{3}(r^2 - 2rx - 3x^2) = \frac{\pi}{3}(r - 3x)(r + x)\)
For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dV}{dx} = 0\). Since \(r + x > 0\), this gives \(x = \frac{r}{3}\).
Again, \(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-2r - 6x)\), and at \(x = \frac{r}{3}\), \(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-4r) < 0\). So V is maximum at \(x = \frac{r}{3}\).
Hence the height of the cone of maximum volume is \(h = r + \frac{r}{3} = \frac{4r}{3}\). Proved.
(Its maximum volume is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot \frac{8r^2}{9} \cdot \frac{4r}{3} = \frac{32\pi r^3}{81}\).)
Q6c.hi:
माना r त्रिज्या के गोले का केन्द्र O है तथा शंकु का शीर्ष P गोले पर स्थित है। शंकु का आधार गोले का एक वृत्त है जिसका केन्द्र M, PO को आगे बढ़ाने पर उस पर स्थित है, तथा \(OM = x\) (\(0 \le x < r\))।
शंकु की ऊँचाई: \(h = PM = r + x\)।
यदि आधार की त्रिज्या R है, तो O, M तथा आधार की परिधि के किसी बिन्दु से बने समकोण त्रिभुज से \(R^2 = r^2 - x^2\)।
शंकु का आयतन:
\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi R^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi (r^2 - x^2)(r + x) = \frac{\pi}{3}(r^3 + r^2x - rx^2 - x^3)\)
x के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर,
\(\frac{dV}{dx} = \frac{\pi}{3}(r^2 - 2rx - 3x^2) = \frac{\pi}{3}(r - 3x)(r + x)\)
उच्चिष्ठ या निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dV}{dx} = 0\)। चूँकि \(r + x > 0\), अतः \(x = \frac{r}{3}\)।
पुनः \(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-2r - 6x)\), तथा \(x = \frac{r}{3}\) पर \(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-4r) < 0\)। अतः \(x = \frac{r}{3}\) पर V अधिकतम है।
अतः अधिकतम आयतन वाले शंकु की ऊँचाई \(h = r + \frac{r}{3} = \frac{4r}{3}\) है। इति सिद्धम्।
(इसका अधिकतम आयतन \(\frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot \frac{8r^2}{9} \cdot \frac{4r}{3} = \frac{32\pi r^3}{81}\) है।)

Q6d.en:
The curve \(y = \sin x\) lies above the x-axis on \([0, \pi]\) and below it on \([\pi, 2\pi]\), so the region (bounded by the curve, the x-axis and the lines \(x = 0\), \(x = 2\pi\)) has two parts and
\(\text{Area} = \int_0^{\pi} \sin x\,dx + \left|\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \sin x\,dx\right|\)
\(\int_0^{\pi} \sin x\,dx = [-\cos x]_0^{\pi} = -\cos\pi + \cos 0 = 1 + 1 = 2\)
\(\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \sin x\,dx = [-\cos x]_{\pi}^{2\pi} = -\cos 2\pi + \cos\pi = -1 - 1 = -2\), whose absolute value is 2.
Hence the required area \(= 2 + 2 = 4\) square units.
Q6d.hi:
वक्र \(y = \sin x\), \([0, \pi]\) पर x-अक्ष के ऊपर तथा \([\pi, 2\pi]\) पर x-अक्ष के नीचे है, अतः (वक्र, x-अक्ष तथा रेखाओं \(x = 0\), \(x = 2\pi\) से घिरे) क्षेत्र के दो भाग हैं और
\(\text{क्षेत्रफल} = \int_0^{\pi} \sin x\,dx + \left|\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \sin x\,dx\right|\)
\(\int_0^{\pi} \sin x\,dx = [-\cos x]_0^{\pi} = -\cos\pi + \cos 0 = 1 + 1 = 2\)
\(\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \sin x\,dx = [-\cos x]_{\pi}^{2\pi} = -\cos 2\pi + \cos\pi = -1 - 1 = -2\), जिसका निरपेक्ष मान 2 है।
अतः अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल \(= 2 + 2 = 4\) वर्ग इकाई।

Q6e.en:
First find the sign of \(x\sin\pi x\) on \(\left[-1, \frac{3}{2}\right]\):
- for \(0 \le x \le 1\): \(x \ge 0\) and \(\sin\pi x \ge 0\), so \(x\sin\pi x \ge 0\)
- for \(-1 \le x < 0\): \(x < 0\) and \(\sin\pi x \le 0\), so \(x\sin\pi x \ge 0\)
- for \(1 < x \le \frac{3}{2}\): \(x > 0\) and \(\sin\pi x < 0\), so \(x\sin\pi x < 0\)
So \(I = \int_{-1}^{1} x\sin\pi x\,dx - \int_{1}^{3/2} x\sin\pi x\,dx\).
Integrating by parts (x as the first function),
\(\int x\sin\pi x\,dx = -\frac{x\cos\pi x}{\pi} + \int \frac{\cos\pi x}{\pi}\,dx = -\frac{x\cos\pi x}{\pi} + \frac{\sin\pi x}{\pi^2} = F(x)\) (say).
\(F(1) = -\frac{\cos\pi}{\pi} + 0 = \frac{1}{\pi}\), \(F(-1) = \frac{\cos(-\pi)}{\pi} + 0 = -\frac{1}{\pi}\), \(F\left(\frac{3}{2}\right) = -\frac{3}{2\pi}\cos\frac{3\pi}{2} + \frac{1}{\pi^2}\sin\frac{3\pi}{2} = -\frac{1}{\pi^2}\).
So \(\int_{-1}^{1} x\sin\pi x\,dx = F(1) - F(-1) = \frac{2}{\pi}\), and \(\int_{1}^{3/2} x\sin\pi x\,dx = F\left(\frac{3}{2}\right) - F(1) = -\frac{1}{\pi^2} - \frac{1}{\pi}\).
Hence
\(\int_{-1}^{3/2} |x\sin\pi x|\,dx = \frac{2}{\pi} + \frac{1}{\pi} + \frac{1}{\pi^2} = \frac{3}{\pi} + \frac{1}{\pi^2}\).
Q6e.hi:
पहले \(\left[-1, \frac{3}{2}\right]\) पर \(x\sin\pi x\) का चिह्न ज्ञात कीजिए:
- \(0 \le x \le 1\) के लिए: \(x \ge 0\) तथा \(\sin\pi x \ge 0\), अतः \(x\sin\pi x \ge 0\)
- \(-1 \le x < 0\) के लिए: \(x < 0\) तथा \(\sin\pi x \le 0\), अतः \(x\sin\pi x \ge 0\)
- \(1 < x \le \frac{3}{2}\) के लिए: \(x > 0\) तथा \(\sin\pi x < 0\), अतः \(x\sin\pi x < 0\)
अतः \(I = \int_{-1}^{1} x\sin\pi x\,dx - \int_{1}^{3/2} x\sin\pi x\,dx\)।
खंडशः समाकलन से (x को प्रथम फलन लेकर),
\(\int x\sin\pi x\,dx = -\frac{x\cos\pi x}{\pi} + \int \frac{\cos\pi x}{\pi}\,dx = -\frac{x\cos\pi x}{\pi} + \frac{\sin\pi x}{\pi^2} = F(x)\) (माना)।
\(F(1) = -\frac{\cos\pi}{\pi} + 0 = \frac{1}{\pi}\), \(F(-1) = \frac{\cos(-\pi)}{\pi} + 0 = -\frac{1}{\pi}\), \(F\left(\frac{3}{2}\right) = -\frac{3}{2\pi}\cos\frac{3\pi}{2} + \frac{1}{\pi^2}\sin\frac{3\pi}{2} = -\frac{1}{\pi^2}\)।
अतः \(\int_{-1}^{1} x\sin\pi x\,dx = F(1) - F(-1) = \frac{2}{\pi}\), तथा \(\int_{1}^{3/2} x\sin\pi x\,dx = F\left(\frac{3}{2}\right) - F(1) = -\frac{1}{\pi^2} - \frac{1}{\pi}\)।
अतः
\(\int_{-1}^{3/2} |x\sin\pi x|\,dx = \frac{2}{\pi} + \frac{1}{\pi} + \frac{1}{\pi^2} = \frac{3}{\pi} + \frac{1}{\pi^2}\)।

Q7a.en:
\(CD - AB = O\) means \(CD = AB\). Since C and AB are \(2 \times 2\) matrices, the matrix D is \(2 \times 2\).
First,
\(AB = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 5 & 2 \\ 7 & 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 10 - 7 & 4 - 4 \\ 15 + 28 & 6 + 16 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 \\ 43 & 22 \end{bmatrix}\)
For the matrix C, \(|C| = 2 \times 8 - 5 \times 3 = 16 - 15 = 1 \ne 0\), so \(C^{-1}\) exists.
\(\text{adj}\,C = \begin{bmatrix} 8 & -5 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\), so \(C^{-1} = \frac{1}{|C|}\,\text{adj}\,C = \begin{bmatrix} 8 & -5 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\).
Premultiplying \(CD = AB\) by \(C^{-1}\): \(C^{-1}CD = C^{-1}(AB)\), that is \(D = C^{-1}(AB)\).
\(D = \begin{bmatrix} 8 & -5 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 \\ 43 & 22 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 24 - 215 & 0 - 110 \\ -9 + 86 & 0 + 44 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -191 & -110 \\ 77 & 44 \end{bmatrix}\)
Check:
\(CD = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 5 \\ 3 & 8 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} -191 & -110 \\ 77 & 44 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -382 + 385 & -220 + 220 \\ -573 + 616 & -330 + 352 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 \\ 43 & 22 \end{bmatrix} = AB\)
Hence \(D = \begin{bmatrix} -191 & -110 \\ 77 & 44 \end{bmatrix}\).
Q7a.hi:
\(CD - AB = O\) का अर्थ है \(CD = AB\)। चूँकि C तथा AB, \(2 \times 2\) आव्यूह हैं, अतः आव्यूह D भी \(2 \times 2\) का होगा।
पहले,
\(AB = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 5 & 2 \\ 7 & 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 10 - 7 & 4 - 4 \\ 15 + 28 & 6 + 16 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 \\ 43 & 22 \end{bmatrix}\)
आव्यूह C के लिए \(|C| = 2 \times 8 - 5 \times 3 = 16 - 15 = 1 \ne 0\), अतः \(C^{-1}\) का अस्तित्व है।
\(\text{adj}\,C = \begin{bmatrix} 8 & -5 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\), अतः \(C^{-1} = \frac{1}{|C|}\,\text{adj}\,C = \begin{bmatrix} 8 & -5 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\)।
\(CD = AB\) को बाईं ओर से \(C^{-1}\) से गुणा करने पर \(C^{-1}CD = C^{-1}(AB)\), अर्थात् \(D = C^{-1}(AB)\)।
\(D = \begin{bmatrix} 8 & -5 \\ -3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 \\ 43 & 22 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 24 - 215 & 0 - 110 \\ -9 + 86 & 0 + 44 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -191 & -110 \\ 77 & 44 \end{bmatrix}\)
जाँच:
\(CD = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 5 \\ 3 & 8 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} -191 & -110 \\ 77 & 44 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -382 + 385 & -220 + 220 \\ -573 + 616 & -330 + 352 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 \\ 43 & 22 \end{bmatrix} = AB\)
अतः \(D = \begin{bmatrix} -191 & -110 \\ 77 & 44 \end{bmatrix}\)।

Q8a.en:
Write \(y = e^{3x}(A\cos 4x + B\sin 4x)\). Differentiating with respect to x,
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 3e^{3x}(A\cos 4x + B\sin 4x) + e^{3x}(-4A\sin 4x + 4B\cos 4x)\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 3y + 4e^{3x}(B\cos 4x - A\sin 4x)\)   ...(1)
so \(4e^{3x}(B\cos 4x - A\sin 4x) = \frac{dy}{dx} - 3y\)   ...(2)
Differentiating (1) again,
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = 3\frac{dy}{dx} + 12e^{3x}(B\cos 4x - A\sin 4x) + 4e^{3x}(-4B\sin 4x - 4A\cos 4x)\)
\(= 3\frac{dy}{dx} + 3 \cdot 4e^{3x}(B\cos 4x - A\sin 4x) - 16e^{3x}(A\cos 4x + B\sin 4x)\)
\(= 3\frac{dy}{dx} + 3\left(\frac{dy}{dx} - 3y\right) - 16y\)   [using (2)]
\(= 6\frac{dy}{dx} - 25y\)
Therefore \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 6\frac{dy}{dx} + 25y = 0\).
So the given function satisfies the differential equation for all values of the arbitrary constants A and B, that is, it is a solution of the equation. Proved.

Q8b.en:
Write the integrand in terms of \(\sin x\) and \(\cos x\):
\(\sqrt{\tan x} + \sqrt{\cot x} = \sqrt{\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}} + \sqrt{\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}} = \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x\cos x}}\)
So \(I = \int \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x\cos x}}\,dx\).
Put \(\sin x - \cos x = t\). Then \((\cos x + \sin x)\,dx = dt\), and squaring, \(1 - 2\sin x\cos x = t^2\), so \(\sin x\cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{2}\).
\(I = \int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{\frac{1 - t^2}{2}}} = \sqrt{2}\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}} = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1} t + C\)
Hence
\(\int \left[\sqrt{\tan x} + \sqrt{\cot x}\right] dx = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1}(\sin x - \cos x) + C\).
Q8b.hi:

Q9a.en:
The equation is linear, of the form \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\), with \(P = \cot x\) and \(Q = 4x\operatorname{cosec} x\).
Integrating factor: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \cot x\,dx} = e^{\log \sin x} = \sin x\).
The solution is \(y \cdot \text{I.F.} = \int Q \cdot \text{I.F.}\,dx + C\):
\(y\sin x = \int 4x\operatorname{cosec} x \cdot \sin x\,dx + C = \int 4x\,dx + C = 2x^2 + C\)
Given \(y = 0\) when \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\):
\(0 \cdot \sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 2\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^2 + C \Rightarrow 0 = \frac{\pi^2}{2} + C \Rightarrow C = -\frac{\pi^2}{2}\)
Hence the particular solution is
\(y\sin x = 2x^2 - \frac{\pi^2}{2}\), that is \(y = \left(2x^2 - \frac{\pi^2}{2}\right)\operatorname{cosec} x\) (\(\sin x \ne 0\)).

Q9bi.en:
Put \(\sin^{-1} x = \theta\), so \(x = \sin\theta\), \(dx = \cos\theta\,d\theta\) and \(\sqrt{1 - x^2} = \cos\theta\).
\(I = \int \frac{\theta\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\cos\theta\,d\theta = \int \theta\sin\theta\,d\theta\)
Integrating by parts (\(\theta\) as the first function),
\(I = \theta(-\cos\theta) - \int 1 \cdot (-\cos\theta)\,d\theta = -\theta\cos\theta + \sin\theta + C\)
Returning to x, with \(\sin\theta = x\) and \(\cos\theta = \sqrt{1 - x^2}\):
\(\int \frac{x\sin^{-1} x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\,dx = x - \sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\sin^{-1} x + C\).
Q9bi.hi:
\(\sin^{-1} x = \theta\) रखिए, तो \(x = \sin\theta\), \(dx = \cos\theta\,d\theta\) तथा \(\sqrt{1 - x^2} = \cos\theta\)।
\(I = \int \frac{\theta\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\cos\theta\,d\theta = \int \theta\sin\theta\,d\theta\)
खंडशः समाकलन से (\(\theta\) को प्रथम फलन लेकर),
\(I = \theta(-\cos\theta) - \int 1 \cdot (-\cos\theta)\,d\theta = -\theta\cos\theta + \sin\theta + C\)
x में वापस लौटने पर, \(\sin\theta = x\) तथा \(\cos\theta = \sqrt{1 - x^2}\):
\(\int \frac{x\sin^{-1} x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\,dx = x - \sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\sin^{-1} x + C\)।

Q9bii.en:
Simplify the bracket with half-angle formulas:
\(\frac{1 + \sin x}{1 + \cos x} = \frac{1 + 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}} = \frac{1}{2}\sec^2\frac{x}{2} + \tan\frac{x}{2}\)
So \(I = \int e^{x}\left(\tan\frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{2}\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\right) dx\).
This has the form \(\int e^{x}[f(x) + f'(x)]\,dx = e^{x}f(x) + C\), with \(f(x) = \tan\frac{x}{2}\) and \(f'(x) = \frac{1}{2}\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\).
Hence \(\int e^{x}\left(\frac{1 + \sin x}{1 + \cos x}\right) dx = e^{x}\tan\frac{x}{2} + C\).
